svg.title: LLM as teacher, XLNet as student
svg.desc: Training runs once per model version: 10,000 structured summaries go to an LLM labeler, which produces training data with a 0 or 1 flag per topic. An LLM check verifies each label. XLNet is fine-tuned on the training data. In production, every day, new summaries go through the fine-tuned XLNet model, which writes a list of topics per call to the call_topic table.
svg.text: is the topic in the summary?
